results.title: 400 DMS Students Protest Proposed KVS Merger In Bhopal, Demand School Retain Separate Identity
results.description: Around 300-400 DMS students and parents protested in Bhopal on Tuesday against the proposed merger of Demonstration Multipurpose School with KVS Carrying “Save DMS” posters, students demanded retention of the school’s separate academic identity and experimental character. They submitted a memorandum to RIE authorities and warned of further protests.

results.title: 1,750 Litres Of Ghee Worth ₹6.8 Lakh Seized In Indore, 18 Samples Sent For Lab Tests
results.description: Food safety officials in Indore seized around 1,750 litres of ghee worth ₹6.80 lakh from Maa Baglamukhi Enterprises in Scheme No. 51. The stock belonged to Gujarat-made Manthan and Shri Anand brands. Officials collected 18 samples from different batches for laboratory testing, with the seized stock to remain in custody until reports arrive.
